sub_answers.sub_question: List all formal criminal or administrative investigations, indictments, prosecutions or plea agreements opened against the politician (naming the investigating agency or prosecutor, charge codes or statutes invoked, case numbers and dates) and state their final disposition (dismissal, conviction, acquittal, plea, settlement, ongoing), with sentence or sanctions if any.
sub_answers.text:
An indictment charging Dušan Knežević with crimes against humanity was issued by the prosecutor of Bosnia and Herzegovina on 7 July 2006 under various subparagraphs of Article 172(1) of the Criminal Code of Bosnia and Herzegovina [d79531218s5p0].
The Court of Bosnia and Herzegovina confirmed the indictments a week after 7 July 2006 and the accused pleaded not guilty on 28 July 2006 [d79531218s5p0].
The trial commenced on 20 December 2006 and the first-instance verdict finding Knežević guilty was rendered on 30 May 2008 with a sentence of 31 years' long-term imprisonment [d79531218s5p0].
Knežević appealed and the appellate panel of the Court of Bosnia and Herzegovina rendered its final and binding verdict on 20 July 2009, confirming his conviction and sentence [d79531218s5p0].
Knežević began serving his sentence at the Penal Correctional Institution in Foča on 24 July 2009 [d79531218s5p0].
